I agree with an earlier poster that [[Silviana Brehon]] is a likely 1st choice - she has the age (born in 849NE - 151 years) which won't put her in a range to be considered an absolute child by Cadsuane. She possesses respectable strength - 15(3) - so other sisters won't be so quick to push her around. And above all she's got the experience after serving under Egwene. But if I was to reflect seriously on this for a moment, I don't think Silviana will want the job. After watching Egwene perish I think Silviana has more than a little PTSD. I mean this is the Aes Sedai who was willing to take Gaywyn's bond on herself to shield Egwene from the grief of loss. That's some serious loyality.

Honestly the broader question I think is the future of [[Aes Sedai]] structure in the [[Fourth Age]]. We are entering an era when 2 of the 7 ajahs don't have a function anymore - Reds will no longer gentle men and there is no shadow for the greens to fight. I think what the real question is - is to ask how Cadsuane will represent a shift in thinking about what the Aes Sedai and the [[White Tower]] represent in the new dawning age.
